name: glucose-server
description: Free Nightscout-compatible glucose server for Cloudflare Workers + D1 (copy, relay or standalone).

API_SECRET.description: Your server's secret, 12 characters or more. Type it in Loop or Trio (as the Nightscout API secret) or in the Glucose Monitor app. **Relay mode:** you may use your Nightscout API secret here.

READ_TOKENS.description: Read-only keys for followers, separated by commas (e.g. `readable-mom,readable-school`).

CARE_TOKENS.description: Keys that can read **and** log treatments (careportal), separated by commas, or `none`. Carbs logged with these keys can reach Loop / Trio and be dosed for: share them only with people who may enter carbs.

NIGHTSCOUT_SECRET.description: Your **Nightscout** API secret, for Copy and Relay modes. Leave empty if it is the same as API_SECRET or if you don't use Nightscout.

NIGHTSCOUT_URL.description: Your Nightscout address (e.g. `https://my-site.herokuapp.com`) to **copy from** it and **relay** to it. Leave empty to use this server on its own (standalone).

SITE_NAME.description: Name shown by apps after connecting.

UNITS.description: `mmol` or `mg/dl` (data is always stored in mg/dL).

KEEP_DAYS.description: Delete data older than this many days. `365` is a safe choice: the free database stops accepting data at 500 MB (`0` = keep everything).
